scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply feedback --local -c db.wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute feedback --local -c db.wrangler.jsonc --file seeds/dev.sql
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node scripts/predeploy-check.mjs db && wrangler d1 migrations apply feedback --remote -c db.wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:public: node scripts/predeploy-check.mjs public && npm run build -w @feedback/public && wrangler deploy --cwd apps/public
scripts.deploy:admin: node scripts/predeploy-check.mjs admin && npm run build -w @feedback/admin && wrangler deploy --cwd apps/admin
